# Implement Feature From Spec

Implement only the requested phase from the feature spec.

## Rules

- Read project instructions, AGENTS and relevant spec files first.
- Do not implement unrelated scope.
- Do not perform broad refactors.
- Preserve public contracts unless spec requires change.
- Follow existing style.
- Add/update tests for changed behavior.
- Document assumptions and risks.

## Before coding

Summarize:
- current flow
- files to inspect/change
- test strategy

## After coding

Summarize:
- files changed
- tests added/updated
- risks
- validation steps
